summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of PrintForge marketplace. All 19 backend pytest tests passed (public endpoints, auth gating, authenticated CRUD on listings/designs, become-seller, file upload/download, Stripe checkout creation w/ 3.5% platform fee, checkout status polling, logout). Frontend tests passed for landing, /browse, /designer (Three.js canvas + shape buttons), /designs, /create (auth gate), /dashboard (auth gate), theme toggle, and SIGN IN redirect to Emergent Auth.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/auth/logout reads token from cookie OR header but never deletes a sessionless token - benign.

server.py: /api/checkout/session allows guest checkout (user can be None) but still requires user['user_id'] for metadata via ternary - currently safe. Consider auth requirement if buyer tracking is needed.
server.py: Stripe webhook signature is currently passed but Stripe-Signature absence isn't validated; consider explicit 400 on missing signature.
Single-file backend (~495 lines) is approaching split threshold; consider modularizing (auth/listings/designs/payments) if it grows further.
/api/checkout/session does not verify listing.status == 'active' before creating Stripe session.
test_credentials: MongoDB-injected sessions per /app/auth_testing.md. Used token test_session_pf_1781507354247 (user test-user-pf-1781507354247) for backend tests; deleted at end via /auth/logout. Frontend tests use no auth (verified gating).
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_ users + sessions via mongosh for backend pytest. Created TEST_Cute Planter listing and TEST_Cube Design via API. One Stripe checkout session opened (no payment completed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_printforge.py covers all critical endpoints incl. Stripe checkout (3.5% fee assertion). To re-run, first inject a fresh session via the mongosh snippet in /app/auth_testing.md and set TEST_SESSION_TOKEN / TEST_USER_ID env vars (or update the constants at top of test_printforge.py). Frontend tested via Playwright - landing hero, nav (BROWSE/DESIGN/COMMUNITY), theme toggle, signin redirect to auth.emergentagent.com, /designer Three.js canvas + shape adders, /create and /dashboard auth gates all confirmed working.
